content.title: Open a security preview by hovering a holding ticker
content.intent: Prove hovering a ticker opens the preview popover with security details without reflowing the page.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: equivalence partitioning over preview-entry modes, with hover treated as a distinct interaction class from explicit activation. strength=2 by risk judgement because no money, auth, or data-loss factors apply; no covering-array sweep was needed because the path has one varying input class.
